What to understand at MT3

Facility AI
A scripting system for performing supported game actions under specified conditions. It is more flexible than a fixed worker assignment.
Specialization
A military choice that opens a particular building’s additional development route. Different choices favor different play styles.

What you are working toward

  • Complete the MT4 module and region requirements. The supplied older table lists 60 maximized modules and 9 regions.
  • Prepare a dependable production loop and combat blueprint before attempting to automate either.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an suggested route based on community strategies. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Improve the blueprint you already understand

    Push more regions with your established attack and survival core. When progress stops, identify whether the problem is damage, survival or time spent farming resources. Buy upgrades that address that specific limit. [S04] [S06]

  2. Use several routes to missing modules

    Consult the module list and mix regional farming with Laboratory, Mine-related rewards and manageable challenges. A difficult random drop is not necessarily the cheapest way to gain one more module toward promotion. [S06]

  3. Write down your repetitive actions

    Notice tasks such as refining an ingredient, crafting an intermediate item or buying in-run module upgrades. Choose one task with a clear starting condition and stopping condition. This gives you a small, understandable first automation instead of a large script whose effects are hard to diagnose. [S07]

  4. Promote, then set up Facility AI

    Unlocking MT4 gives access to Facility AI; inspect its controls and relevant research in Headquarters. Test a small script while watching it. Confirm that it acts on the intended building, has its required inputs, and stops or waits appropriately when those inputs run out. Building-dependent actions may require the relevant interface to be open. Do not assume scripts run offline. [S02] [S07]

  5. Choose a specialization for your actual goal

    The supplied community advice favors Power Plant/Dyson Sphere for tower-testing boosts, with Mine/Asteroid Mining as an alternative for varied rewards. Factory expansion can be valuable but demanding to develop early. Compare the current perk descriptions and costs; this is a recommendation, not a universal best choice. [S04] [S05]

If you are stuck

My first script does nothing

Check that its required feature is researched, the correct task is selected, the needed inputs exist, and the relevant building is open where required. Test one action before a full loop.

Automation produces the wrong material

Stop it and simplify the task. Verify quantities and conditions manually before allowing it to repeat.

Ready to move on?

  • Headquarters shows MT4 ready.
  • You have a short list of useful first automation tasks.
After the promotion

At MT4, the next wall is collecting and maximizing many modules. Use automation to support that workload, then aim for Wave Momentum at MT5. [S02] [S05] [S07]
